components.cost_effect: One block gradient and one exact block minimization per iteration.
components.goal: Obtain a nonincreasing objective with an inexpensive block update.
components.key_estimate: Eq.(8): F(x+Ui t)<=f(x)+V_i(x,t)+sum_{j!=i}Psi_j(x^(j)); comparison of the minimizer with t=0 gives F(x_{k+1})<=F(x_k).
components.name: Selected-block majorant minimization
components.operation: Minimize V_i(x,t)=<nabla_i f(x),t>+(Li/2)||t||_(i)^2+Psi_i(x^(i)+t) exactly, then add Ui t.
components.requires: Block Lipschitz smoothness, separability and access to the exact block minimizer.
transfer_checks: Inexact block solves need a new decrease analysis.
Nonseparable constraints cannot be inserted into this block subproblem without checking feasibility and the majorant decomposition.
Changing the conditional sampling probabilities changes the expected-decrease identity used by the linked theorem.

content.family: Block quadratic majorization with uniform randomized block updates

limitations.statement: The iteration guarantee counts selected-block operations; it provides neither an unrestricted Oracle Complexity lower bound nor an arithmetic-cost guarantee for exact block minimization.
The finite radius assumption and optimum-dependent initial gap used by the bound do not constitute an implementable stopping certificate when unavailable to the user.

performance_links.scope_note: Theorem 4(i), Eq.(27), under all its stated assumptions; selected UCDC performance only.

variants.cost: Per iteration: one selected-block gradient evaluation, one exact selected-block quadratic-proximal minimization, one uniform block draw and one block-vector update. After K iterations, K calls of each of the first two primitives. Cost of solving the block subproblem, block arithmetic, storage, preprocessing and obtaining valid Li/radius/gap information are separate resources, with no universal scalar-operation bound supplied here. Objective evaluation and full gradient evaluation are not required by the update.
variants.implementation_details_ref: §2, PDF pp.6–8, Eqs.(2)–(10), Algorithm 1; §3, PDF p.10, Algorithm 2.
variants.name: UCDC, Algorithm 2
variants.output: Last iterate x_K in dom Psi; no best-iterate selection or averaging.
public_inputs: Block partition Ui, block matrices Bi, positive block Lipschitz constants Li, access to Psi_i and its exact quadratic-proximal minimizer, feasible initial x0 and an integer iteration budget K.

For the Theorem 4(i) budget: epsilon, rho, Delta0=F(x0)-F* and R_L(x0), or valid information sufficient to choose a budget satisfying that theorem. These geometric and optimum-dependent quantities are not supplied by the update oracle.
variants.query_and_update: At each k=0,...,K-1, draw i uniformly from {1,...,n}, with conditional probability 1/n given the past. Query g=nabla_i f(x_k). Compute h=argmin_{t in R^Ni}{<g,t>+(Li/2)||t||_(i)^2+Psi_i(x_k^(i)+t)} exactly. Set x_{k+1}=x_k+Ui h, leaving every other block unchanged.
variants.requirements: f:R^N->R is differentiable convex. For all x,t,i, ||nabla_i f(x+Ui t)-nabla_i f(x)||*_(i)<=Li||t||_(i), Li>0, with dual norm induced by Bi^(-1). Psi=sum_i Psi_i is proper closed convex extended-real-valued and block separable. Exact selected-block gradient and exact minimization of the displayed block subproblem are available. Finite attained F* and finite R_L(x0) are required for the linked convex high-probability guarantee, rather than for defining a single update.
variants.state_and_initialization: Store x=x0 in dom Psi, with x0 in R^N. Partition R^N into n blocks using a column permutation U=[U1,...,Un] of I_N. Each Bi is positive definite and ||t||_(i)^2=<Bi t,t>. No momentum, averaging or restart state is used.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Use Li in the quadratic term. The source loop is indefinite; stop after a chosen integer K and return x_K. For the linked bound choose 0<epsilon<Delta0, 0<rho<1, C=2n max{R_L(x0)^2,Delta0}, and K>=(C/epsilon)(1+log(1/rho))+2-C/Delta0. No objective-value stopping test is required by this fixed-budget implementation.

use_restrictions: Exact block minimization is a separately charged primitive; no unrestricted Oracle Complexity claim.
